inputs.goal: monthly active accounts by plan, against the warehouse schema

intake.summary: Executing query to count monthly active accounts by plan from warehouse schema

generate.draft: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', account_created_date) AS month, plan_type, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS monthly_active_accounts FROM warehouse.accounts WHERE account_status = 'active' GROUP BY month, plan_type ORDER BY month, plan_type
